name: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise

paragraphs.text: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape from Paradise (titled Sammy's Great Escape in the UK, Sammy 2: Escape from Paradise everywhere else; , literally "Sammy's adventures 2") is a 2012 animated film sequel to the 2010 animated film A Turtle's Tale: Sammy's Adventures. The sequel features the voice talents of Kaitlyn Maher, Khary Payton and Carlos Alazraqui.
On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, 20% of ten critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of 4/10.
